CASES = [

    (['ℝ', 'inferInstance', 'Set.Icc 0 2', 'Set.Icc 0 1', 'isCompact_Icc', 'isClosed_Icc', '(Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (by norm_num))'], False, 'have key : ∀ (E : Type) [inst1 : TopologicalSpace E] (K C : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) (hC : IsClosed C) (hCK : C ⊆ K), IsCompact C := by\n  intro E inst1 K C hK hC hCK\n  exact (hK.of_isClosed_subset hC hCK)\nexact @key (ℝ) (inferInstance) (Set.Icc 0 2) (Set.Icc 0 1) (isCompact_Icc) (isClosed_Icc) ((Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl (by norm_num)))'),
]
